m-04.title: Kutenga zvokudya zvidiki ne 5000원
m-04.goal: Tsvaga nzira dzakati wandei dzekusangana nemamiriro akati wandei panguva imwe chete, uye utsanangure kuti ungadzitsvaga sei dzese pasina kushaya nekuti sei dzimwe nyaya dzisingabviri.
m-04.material: Boka redu revanhu 10 rinoda kutenga zvokudya zvidiki zvepati. Machipisi anodhura 600원 pabhegi, jellii inodhura 400원 pabhegi, uye zvinwiwa zvinodhura 500원 pabhodhoro. Tinoshandisa 5000원 chaizvo, tinotenga imwe kana kupfuura yerudzi rwega rwega rwatatu, uye tinotenga zvinhu 10 kana kupfuura pamwe chete kuti munhu wega wega awane chimwe.
m-04.thinking.0: Kugadzira mhinduro dzakati wandei mukati memiganho
m-04.thinking.2: Kutsanangura nyaya dzisingabviri nenhamba dzakaenzana nedzisina kuenzana
m-04.prereq.0: Kuverenga huwandu hwemari nekuwanza nekuwedzera (padanho reGiredhi 3-4)
m-04.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira zvirongwa zvekutenga zvakasiyana 3 zvinosangana nemamiriro ese.
m-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti utenge zvingani zverudzi rumwe, wobva watarisa kana unogona kutenga marudzi maviri akasara nemari yasara.
m-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kana huwandu huri pasi kana pamusoro pe 5000원, shandura huwandu hwerudzi rumwe chimwe panguva imwe kugadzirisa musiyano.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Unofanira kutenga rimwe kana kupfuura rerudzi rwega rwega rwatatu.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c3: Huwandu hwose hahusi 5000원. Wedzera mari yerudzi rwega rwega kuti utarise.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c4: Pane zvinhu zvishoma pa 10 dzose, saka munhu wega wega haagoni kuwana chimwe.
m-04.s.s1.explain: Semuenzaniso, (machipisi, jellii, zvinwiwa) = (4, 4, 2) ndi 2400+1600+1000=5000원 uye zvinhu 10. (3, 3, 4), (2, 2, 6), (1, 1, 8), (2, 7, 2), ne (1, 6, 4) dzese dzinosangana nemamiriro zvakare.
m-04.s.s2.prompt: Mushure mekuwana nzira imwe, unoda kuwana dzimwe pasina kushaya. Nzira yakanakisa ndeipi?
m-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isa nzira dzawakawana patafura uye utarise kurongeka kwawakadzitsvaga nako.
m-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, enzanisa "kuti unotsvaga kusvika papi mushure mekuwana imwe" ne "kuti unogona kuziva here kuti wadzipedza dzese."
m-04.s.s2.o.a: Seta huwandu hwemabhegi emachipisi se 1, 2, 3... nenzira, uye umire pakarepo painobuda nzira imwe
m-04.s.s2.r.a: Kuenda nenzira zvakanaka. Asi kana ukamira mushure mekuwana imwe, haugoni kuziva kana pane nzira dzimwe. Unofanira kuenda kure zvinobvira kuti uwane dzese pasina kushaya.
m-04.s.s2.o.b: Edza kuverenga sezvazvinouya mupfungwa uye chengeta dziya dzinoita 5000원 chete, uye umire kana pasina dzimwe dzinobuda
m-04.s.s2.r.b: Unogona kuwana nzira shoma. Asi haugoni kuziva kana "wadzipedza dzese." Kuti uwane dzese pasina kushaya, unoda kurongeka.
m-04.s.s2.o.c: Seta huwandu hwemabhodhoro ezvinwiwa se 1, 2, 3... kusvikira pakupedzisira nenzira, uye kune rimwe nerimwe, tarisa kana zvakasara zvingatengwa nemari yasara
m-04.s.s2.r.c: Nzira yakanaka. Kana ukagadzirisa rudzi rumwe nenzira kusvika pakupedzisira ukatarisa zvakasara, unogona kuziva kuti wasvika papi, saka unogona kuwana dzese pasina kushaya.
m-04.s.s2.o.d: Kana huwandu huri pamusoro pe 5000원, deredza marudzi ese matatu rimwe rimwe woverenga zvakare, uye udzokorore
m-04.s.s2.r.d: Marudzi matatu ane mitengo yakasiyana, saka kuadzikisa zvakaenzana hakugadzirisi musiyano. Zviri nyore kugadzirisa nekushandura rudzi rumwe panguva imwe.
m-04.s.s2.explain: Kana ukagadzirisa rudzi rumwe nenzira, kusvika kure zvinobvira, uye ukatarisa zvakasara, unogona kuziva kuti wasvika papi, saka unogona kuwana dzese pasina kushaya. Semuenzaniso, unotarisa nekuseta zvinwiwa se bhodhoro 1, mabhodhoro 2, mabhodhoro 3, nezvimwewo.
m-04.s.s3.prompt: Chokwadi (kana uchida kuedza chete): Munzira dzawakawana, huwandu hwemabhodhoro ezvinwiwa (500원) ndi 2, 4, 6, kana 8, kugara zvakaenzana. Hapana nzira yekutenga huwandu husina kuenzana hwemabhodhoro ezvinwiwa (1, 3, 5...) here? Tsanangura nemazwi ako kuti sei. Kufunga nezvenhamba dzakaenzana nedzisina kuenzana, mayuniti e 200원, kana tafura zvese zvakanaka.
m-04.s.s3.hint.0: Shandura 600원, 400원, ne 500원 kuva huwandu hwemabhandi e 100원 uye unyore se 6, 4, ne 5.
m-04.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga mari yasara kana ukatenga bhodhoro 1 nemabhodhoro 3 ezvinwiwa, uye utarise kana unogona kuita mari iyoyo nemachipisi nejellii.
m-04.s.s3.placeholder: Semuenzaniso: Mutengo wemachipisi nejellii ndi ... Kana huwandu hwemabhodhoro ezvinwiwa husina kuenzana, ...
m-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here kuti chii chakasarudzika nehuwandu hwaunowana nekuwedzera mitengo yemachipisi nejellii?
m-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaenderera here kunyora kuti sei huwandu hwose husingagoni kuva 5000원 kana huwandu hwemabhodhoro ezvinwiwa husina kuenzana?
m-04.s.s3.model.0: Kana ukaunganidza 600원 ne 400원 ne 100원, unowana mabhandi 6 nemabhandi 4, zvese zvakaenzana. 5000원 ndi mabhandi 50, akaenzana. Chinwiwa ndi mabhandi 5, saka nehuwandu husina kuenzana hwemabhodhoro huwandu hunova husina kuenzana uye hahugoni kuva 50, iyo yakaenzana.
m-04.s.s3.model.1: Chips pa 600원 ne jelly pa 400원 zvose i ma multiples e 200원, saka huwandu hwazvo i multiple ye 200 zvakare. Huwandu hweodd hwemabhodhoro emadhirinki i 500, 1500, 2500..., uye kugovanisa ne 200 kunosiya 100. Saka kuzviwedzera hakugone kuita 5000원.
m-04.s.s3.model.2: Ne bhodhoro 1 remadhirinki, mari yasara i 4500원, asi huwandu hupi hwacho hunoitwa ne 600원 ne 400원 i multiple ye 200, saka 4500 haigone kuitwa. Ne mabhodhoro 3 kana 5, mari yasara haisi multiple ye 200 zvakare, saka hazvishande.

m-02.title: Tinoda chii chimwe kugadzirisa dambudziko iri?
m-02.goal: Dzidza kuti kuti dambudziko rinogona kugadziriswa here hakuenderani nokuti panenhamba here asi nokuti ruzivo runodikanwa kune zvaunobvunzwa riripo here, taura chaizvo kuti ruzivo rupi rwunoshaikwa, uye utsanangure kuti sei quotient inofanira kutenderedzwa kumusoro mukukamura kune chasara.
m-02.material:
Vadzidzi vari kuenda parwendo vanoda kupatsanura kuva mavan. Pane madambudziko mana pazasi.
a) Vadzidzi 28 vanopatsanura uye vanokwira mavan. Van imwe inogona kutakura vadzidzi 9 zvakanyanya. Mavan mangani anodikanwa pashoma?
b) Vadzidzi 28 vanoenda parwendo. Mari yekupinda ndi 2000원 pamudzidzi, uye mari yekurenda van ndi 90000원 paivan. Huwandu hwose hwemari yekupinda yevadzidzi vese ndehupi?
c) Vadzidzi vanopatsanura uye vanokwira mavan. Van imwe inogona kutakura vadzidzi 9 zvakanyanya. Mavan mangani anodikanwa pashoma?
d) Vadzidzi 28 vanoenda parwendo. Van imwe inogona kutakura vadzidzi 9 zvakanyanya. Zvinodhura zvakadini zvose kurenda mavan?
m-02.thinking.2: Kugadzira makosha akati wandei anowirirana nemamiriro
m-02.s.s1.prompt: Verenga dambudziko rega rega zvakasiyana uye usarudze madambudziko ese anogona kupindurwa uchishandisa ruzivo rwuri mudambudziko iroro chete.
m-02.s.s1.hint.0: Mumadambudziko ese mana, nyora mutsetse pasi pezvaunobvunzwa.
m-02.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti nhamba dzipi dzaunoda kuverenga zvaunobvunzwa, uye utarise rimwe nerimwe kana riri mudambudziko. Maka nhamba dzipi neipi dzisingashandiswi.
m-02.s.s1.r.a: Kana wakashaya dambudziko a): rine vadzidzi vese 28 nehuwandu hwevanogona kutakurwa 9 paivan, saka rinogona kugadziriswa.
m-02.s.s1.r.b: Kana wakashaya dambudziko b): kunyange ruzivo rusingashandiswi mumhinduro, sa mari yekurenda, rwakasanganiswa, unogona kuwana "huwandu hwose hwemari yekupinda" yaunobvunzwa ne 28×2000. Kuva neruzivo rwakawandisa kwakasiyana nekushaya ruzivo.
m-02.s.s1.r.c: Kana wakasarudza dambudziko c): kunyange nhamba dzakapiwa, pane ruzivo rwaunoda chaizvo kuwana mhinduro. Tarisazve kuti nhamba dzipi dzaunoda kuverenga zvaunobvunzwa.
m-02.s.s1.r.d: Kana wakasarudza dambudziko d): unogona kuwana huwandu hwemavan (4), asi kuti uwane mutengo unoda mari yekurenda van imwe. Dambudziko iri harina nhamba iyoyo.
m-02.s.s1.explain: Dambudziko a) rinogona kugadziriswa nokuti rine vadzidzi 28 nehuwandu hwevanogona kutakurwa 9 paivan. Dambudziko b) harishandisi mari yekurenda, asi rinogona kugadziriswa ne "mari yekupinda × huwandu hwevadzidzi" (2000×28=56000원). Dambudziko c) haritauri kuti vadzidzi vangani, uye dambudziko d) haripi mari yekurenda van imwe, saka hazvigoni kugadziriswa. Unogona kugadzirisa dambudziko kunyange paine ruzivo rusingadikanwi, asi kana ruzivo runodikanwa ruchishayikwa, haugoni kurigadzirisa zvisinei kuti pane nhamba dzingani.
m-02.s.s2.prompt: Unofanira kubvunza chii mudzidzisi akanyora dambudziko kuti ugone kugadzirisa dambudziko c)?
m-02.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa nhamba dziri mudambudziko c) nenhamba dziri mudambudziko a) padivi pedzimwe.
m-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga ruzivo rwuri mudambudziko a) asi risiri mudambudziko c).
m-02.s.s2.r.a: Mubvunzo wakanaka. Huwandu hwevadzidzi inhamba yaunoda chaizvo kune zvaunobvunzwa (huwandu hwemavan), uye haipo mudambudziko.
m-02.s.s2.r.b: Mavan mangani anodikanwa ndizvo zvaunobvunzwa. Kubvunza zvaunobvunzwa hakusi mubvunzo unowana ruzivo.
m-02.s.s2.o.c: Vadzidzi vangani vanogona kukwira van imwe?
m-02.s.s2.r.c: Ruzivo urwu rwatopo mudambudziko c). Verenga dambudziko zvakare uye utsvage ruzivo rupi runoshaikwa.
m-02.s.s2.r.d: Mari yekurenda ruzivo runoshandiswa chete mushure mekuziva "mavan mangani." Haishandiswi kuwana kuti mavan mangani anodikanwa.
m-02.s.s2.explain: Dambudziko c) rine huwandu hwevanogona kutakurwa paivan asi harina huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi. Unoda zvese huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi nehuwandu hwevanogona kutakurwa paivan kuti uwane "mavan mangani."
m-02.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza huwandu hwevadzidzi kuti mavan 3 chaizvo adikanwe, uye utsvage huwandu hwevadzidzi hwakasiyana 3 hunoshanda. (Huwandu hwevanogona kutakurwa paivan ndi 9.)
m-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga vanhu vazhinji zvakanyanya vanogona kutakurwa nemavan 2 nevazhinji zvakanyanya vanogona kutakurwa nemavan 3.
m-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza huwandu hwevadzidzi uye uverenge nemaoko kuti mavan mangani anodikanwa kuvatakura.
m-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Ndapota shandisa nhamba yakazara ye 1 kana kupfuura sehuwandu hwevadzidzi.
m-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Nehuwandu uhu hwevadzidzi, huwandu hwemavan haisi 3. Tarisa huwandu hukuru hunogona kutakurwa nemavan 3 nekana mavan 2 akakwana.
m-02.s.s3.explain: Mavan 2 anogona kutakura vadzidzi 18 zvakanyanya, uye mavan 3 anogona kutakura 27. Saka kana pane vadzidzi 19 kusvika 27 (zvinogoneka 9), mavan 3 chaizvo anodikanwa.
m-02.s.s4.prompt: Nevadzidzi 27 unoda mavan 3, uye nevadzidzi 28 unoda mavan 4. 28÷9=3.11…, saka sei mavan 4 uye kwete 3?
m-02.s.s4.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti vadzidzi vangani vanogona kukwira kana mavan ese 3 azara zvakakwana.
m-02.s.s4.hint.1: Wobva waenzanisa izvozvo nevadzidzi 28 uye utarise kana pane munhu asara.
m-02.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Tsananguro yako inosanganisira here huwandu hukuru hunogona kutakurwa nemavan 3?
m-02.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti mudzidzi asara anofanirawo kukwira van?
m-02.s.s4.model.0: Mavan 3 anogona kutakura vadzidzi 27 chete, saka mudzidzi 1 anosara. Mudzidzi uyo 1 anofanira kukwirawo, saka van imwe inodikanwa, zvichiita mavan 4.
m-02.s.s4.model.1: Kana ukaisa vadzidzi 28 mumavan 3, 27 chete vanogona kukwira uye 1 haakwiri. Saka unoda mavan 4. Haugoni kungosiya chikamu chiri mushure mepoindi redecimal.
m-02.s.s4.model.2: Mavan 3 haagoni kutakura vadzidzi vese 28. Kunyange azere anotakura 27, saka mudzidzi 1 anosara uye tinoda van imwe zvakare.
m-02.s.s4.model.3: 28 yakakamurwa ne 9 ndi 3 ne 1 yasara, asi mudzidzi asara anofanirawo kukwira, saka tinoda van imwe zvakare.

m-11.title: Tinoda kuziva chii kusarudza quadratic function?
m-11.goal: Tonga kuti maseti eruzivo api anosarudza quadratic function yega, uye, kumaseti ane ruzivo rushoma, ratidza ma functions maviri akasiyana anosangana nemamiriro iwe pachako kusarudza kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwunodiwa.
m-11.material: Unoda kuwana equation yequadratic function f(x)=ax²+bx+c (a≠0). Pakati pemaseti eruzivo ari pazasi, unoda kuwana aya apo ruzivo irworwo rwoga runosarudza equation yega.
m-11.thinking.1: Kuratidza kuti ruzivo rusingakwani nemienzaniso miviri yakasiyana
m-11.prereq.0: Mhando nhatu dzequadratic function (standard form, vertex form, factored form)
m-11.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza maseti ose apo ruzivo irworwo rwoga runosarudza quadratic function yega.
m-11.s.s1.hint.0: Mu f(x)=ax²+bx+c, tanga waverenga kuti zvisingazivikanwi zvingani zvaunofanira kuwana.
m-11.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe inopa equations (mamiriro) dzakasiyana dzingani, uye kana mamiriro iwayo achisarudza a, b, ne c dzose.
m-11.s.s1.o.a: Vertex, nepoinzi imwe iri pagirafu isiri vertex
m-11.s.s1.r.a: Kana iri vertex, p ne q dzinosarudzwa muna f(x)=a(x−p)²+q, uye poinzi imwe inosarudza a.
m-11.s.s1.o.b: Mapoinzi maviri akasiyana pagirafu, nechokwadi chekuti girafu inovhurika kumusoro
m-11.s.s1.r.b: Pane maparabola asingaverengeki anovhurika kumusoro anopfuura mapoinzi maviri. Nzira yekuvhurika inokuudza chiratidzo che a chete, kwete kukosha kwe a.
m-11.s.s1.o.c: Mapoinzi maviri apo inosangana ne x-axis, ne x-coordinate yevertex
m-11.s.s1.r.c: X-coordinate ye vertex iri pakati chaipo pema x-intercept maviri, saka haisi ruzivo rutsva. a ichiri kusara. Edza kuwedzera (x−1)(x−3) ne2 kana −5.
m-11.s.s1.o.d: Mapoinzi matatu pa graph ane x-coordinate dzakasiyana
m-11.s.s1.r.d: Mapoinzi matatu anopa ma equation matatu anozvimiririra mu a, b, ne c, saka inotarwa kuva imwe chete.
m-11.s.s1.o.e: Equation ye axis of symmetry ne y-intercept
m-11.s.s1.r.e: Axis of symmetry inotara hukama humwe pakati pe a ne b, uye y-intercept inotara c. Verenga kuti makosha ose matatu a, b, ne c anotarwa here.
m-11.s.s1.o.f: Mapoinzi maviri apo inosangana ne x-axis, nepoinzi imwe yakasiyana pa graph
m-11.s.s1.r.f: Mu f(x)=a(x−p)(x−q), p ne q zvinotarwa, uye poinzi imwe inotara a.
m-11.s.s1.explain: Pane ma unknown matatu, a, b, ne c, saka unoda mamiriro matatu anozvimiririra. D: mapoinzi matatu anopa ma simultaneous equation matatu. A: vertex inotara p ne q mu f(x)=a(x−p)²+q, uye poinzi imwe inotara a. F: p ne q zvinotarwa mu f(x)=a(x−p)(x−q), uye poinzi imwe inotara a. B, C, ne E dzine mamiriro maviri anozvimiririra chete, saka a inosara. (Kana mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse wakananga, hapana quadratic function iripo, saka pasi pemamiriro ekuti iquadratic function, mapoinzi matatu haasi pamutsetse wakananga.)
m-11.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kuratidza kuti ruzivo rwesarudzo E, "y-intercept ndi1 uye axis of symmetry ndi x=2," haritari equation oga. Gadzira ma quadratic function maviri akasiyana f(x)=ax²+bx+c anogutsa mamiriro ose maviri aya.
m-11.s.s2.hint.0: Axis of symmetry ndi x=−b/(2a), saka nyora hukama pakati pe a ne b hunoita kuti izvi zvienzane ne2.
m-11.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza a kutanga, wobva wakwanisa b ne c kumamiriro. Tarisa kuti mamiriro achiri kushanda kana ukachinja a.
m-11.s.s2.fail.c1: a haifaniri kuva 0 kuti ive quadratic function.
m-11.s.s2.fail.c2: Y-intercept ndiko kukosha kwaunowana kana ukaisa x=0, f(0)=c. Iyi haisi 1.
m-11.s.s2.fail.c3: Axis of symmetry ndi x=−b/(2a). Tarisa kuti kukosha uku ndi2 here.
m-11.s.s2.explain: Kana axis of symmetry iri x=2, ipapo −b/(2a)=2, saka b=−4a, uye kana y-intercept iri 1, ipapo c=1. Ipapo a inogona kuva kukosha kupi neipi kusiri 0, saka semuenzaniso x²−4x+1 ne 2x²−8x+1 dzose dzinogutsa mamiriro. Sezvo a isina kusungwa, equation haitarwi.
m-11.s.s3.prompt: Unoda kuwana ruzivo rumwe rwekuwedzera ku "y-intercept ndi1 uye axis of symmetry ndi x=2" (sarudzo E) kuti equation itarwe kuva imwe chete. Waizobvunza mubvunzo upi munhu akanyora dambudziko? Nyora mubvunzo uye, mumutsara mumwe kana miviri, kuti nei ruzivo irworwo rwunotara equation.
m-11.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti ndeipi pa a, b, ne c yatotarwa nesarudzo E uye ndeipi yausingazivi.
m-11.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti ruzivo rupi waigona kuisa mu equation kuti utare a.
m-11.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Imwe poinzi iyo graph inopfuura napo ...
m-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ruzivo rwawakasarudza runotara unknown yasara (a) kuva imwe chete here?
m-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndiruzivo rusingapindirani neruzivo rwaunatoita (y-intercept ne axis of symmetry) here?
m-11.s.s3.model.0: Bvunza poinzi imwe iyo graph inopfuura napo isiri pa x=0 kana x=4. Mapoinzi pa x=0 ne x=4 akafanana nezvaunoziva kare, saka haasi ruzivo rutsva. Kuisa imwe poinzi kunotara a kuva imwe chete.
m-11.s.s3.model.1: Bvunza kuti minimum (kana maximum) value ndeyei. Kukosha pa axis of symmetry x=2 ndiyo minimum, saka f(2)=1−4a inotarwa uye unogona kuwana a.
m-11.s.s3.model.2: Bvunza coefficient a ye x². b ne c zvatotarwa, saka kana uchiziva a, equation inotarwa kuva imwe chete.

m-03.title: Kufungidzira zviri mukati mebhegi remabhora
m-03.goal: Shandura kufungidzira kwako kwekutanga sedata rinowedzera, uye utaure kuti sei haufaniri kuva nechokwadi kubva pamhedzisiro yekudhonza kushoma.
m-03.material: Bhegi risingaoneki mukati rine mabhora 10 dzose, matsvuku nemabhuruu. Unodhonza bhora rimwe, unotarisa ruvara rwaro, woridzosera, uye unoita izvi kakawanda. Hauzivi kuti pane mabhora mangani eruvara rwega rwega.
m-03.thinking.0: Kushandura kutonga kwako kana waona data itsva
m-03.thinking.1: Kubatanidza huwandu hwedata nekuti une chokwadi zvakadini
m-03.thinking.2: Kubatanidza mhedzisiro kusarudza tsananguro inonzwisisika zvakanyanya
m-03.prereq.0: Kunyora chikamu chechose sefraction kana pesenti (padanho reGiredhi 5-6)
m-03.s.s1.prompt: Data rinoratidzwa zvishoma nezvishoma. Padanho rega rega, sarudza pfungwa yako pamusoro pezviri mubhegi.

m-06.goal: Dzidza kuti kugovanisa mativi ose maviri e equation ne expression ine variable kunogona kurasikirwa nemhinduro kana ukasiya mukana wekuti i 0, gadzirisa gadziriso, uye ugadzire equation apo chinhu chimwechete chinoitika.

m-06.s.s1.line.2: Kuisa x = 3 kunopa 3² = 9 ne 3×3 = 9, saka inoshanda.
m-06.s.s1.line.3: Saka mhinduro yega ye equation iyi i x = 3.

Nzvimbo dzisina kururama i mutsetse we 2 nemutsetse we 4. Pamutsetse we 2, mativi ose maviri akagovaniswa ne x, asi x ingava 0, uye haugone kugovanisa ne 0. m-12.title: Kutarisa dambudziko rimwe re arithmetic sequence
m-12.goal: Wana kuti mu arithmetic sequence, ma term ane index dzinowedzera kusvika pahuwandu hwakafanana ane huwandu hwema term hwakafanana, kuti dambudziko rinoita sekunge rinoshaya ruzivo rigone kugadziriswa, uye ugadzire dambudziko rinoshandisa maitiro aya iwe pachako.
m-12.material: Pane dambudziko: mu arithmetic sequence {aₙ}, kana a₃ + a₇ = 20, tsvaga kukosha kwe a₅. Suyoung akati, "Hatizivi first term kana common difference, saka hatigoni kuridzivisa." (Ngatitii first term ndi a uye common difference ndi d. a₃ zvinoreva term yechi3, a₇ term yechi7, uye a₅ term yechi5.)

m-12.thinking.1: Kutonga zvakare kuti ruzivo rwakakwana here

m-12.s.s2.o.a: a₅ yakasiyana pasequence imwe neimwe, saka ruzivo urwu oga haruzogoni kutara a₅
m-12.s.s2.r.a: Tarisa zvakare makosha awakaverenga. Funga kuti common difference inowedzerwa kangani ku first term kuti uwane a₅.
m-12.s.s2.o.b: a₅ ndiko kukosha kumwe chete musequence yese, saka ruzivo urwu oga runotara a₅
m-12.s.s2.r.b: Kunyangwe first term ne common difference zvakasiyana kune sequence imwe neimwe, a₅ yaiva imwe chete kune dzose. Yaigona kugadziriswa kunyangwe ruzivo rwaiita sekunge runoshayikwa.
m-12.s.s2.o.c: Common difference ichikura, a₅ inokura, saka unofanira kuziva common difference kuti utare a₅
m-12.s.s2.r.c: Verenga chaizvo a₅ kana common difference iri 0, 1, ne2 uye utarise kuti inochinja here. Cherekedza kuti first term yakachinjawo.
m-12.s.s2.o.d: First term ichikura, a₅ inokura, saka unofanira kuziva first term kuti utare a₅
m-12.s.s2.r.d: Verenga chaizvo a₅ kana first term iri 10, 6, ne2. Common difference yakachinjawo.

m-12.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza nyaya dzose apo, kana uchiudzwa kukosha kwehuwandu hwema term maviri aₘ+aₙ senge a₃+a₇, unogona kutsvaga a₅ pasina kuziva first term ne common difference. (Unogona kuziva nekuyedza nema sequence akati wandei awakagadzira kare.)

m-09.title: Yakaita positive. Mukana wekuti yakaipa uri upi?

m-01.s.s1.prompt: Mutsara upi wenharo yaMinji wakaoma kuvimba nawo? Sarudza mutsara mumwe.
m-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga tarisa kuti kuverenga kuri kutatu kwose kwakarurama here.
m-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora padivi pemumwe nhamba dzakawedzerwa naMinji, 4, 2, ne6, uye utarise kuti pane zvinofanana here.
m-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka chero nhamba yaunowedzera nayo, mhedzisiro inogara iri huru kupfuura nhamba yawakatanga nayo.

Dambudziko hariri "Mienzaniso yakarurama here?" asi "Unogona kuenda kure sei nemienzaniso mishoma chete?" Mutsara wekupedzisira ndiwo usina kururama. Minji akatarisa mienzaniso mitatu chete apo nhamba dzakawedzerwa, 4, 2, ne6, dzose dzakafanana rudzi, wobva ati "chero nhamba yaunowedzera nayo, nguva dzose." Kunyangwe nemienzaniso yakawanda, kana pane rudzi rwenhamba rwausina kuedza, "nguva dzose" haivimbisi.
m-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso miviri ine multiplier dzakasiyana inoratidza kuti chirevo chaMinji hachina kururama. Shandisa nhamba yakazara ye1 kana kupfuura senhamba yekutanga uye nhamba huru kupfuura 0 se multiplier (nhamba yakazara kana decimal zvinobvumirwa), uye product haifaniri kuva huru kupfuura nhamba yekutanga.

m-10.title: Kana f'(a)=0, ikukosha kwakanyanyisa here?
m-10.goal: Shandisa data yeshanduko dzechiratidzo cheiderivative sehumbowo kutonga chirevo che "Kana f'(a)=0, ikukosha kwakanyanyisa," vaka counterexample, uye utaure mamiriro ekuti ive kukosha kwakanyanyisa.
m-10.material:
Jihun akati, "Kune function f, kana f'(a)=0, saka ine kukosha kwakanyanyisa (maximum kana minimum) pa x=a." Akaongorora chiratidzo cheiderivative f'(x) yema functions matatu padhuze ne x=0.
Function | f'(x) | f'(−1) | f'(−0.1) | f'(0) | f'(0.1) | f'(1)
f(x)=x² | 2x | − | − | 0 | + | +
f(x)=x³ | 3x² | + | + | 0 | + | +
f(x)=−x⁴ | −4x³ | + | + | 0 | − | −
(+ ne − mutebhura zviratidzo zvemakoshero ederivative. Verenga x², x³, ne −x⁴ se "x squared," "x cubed," ne "negative x to the fourth.")
m-10.prereq.1: Chiratidzo cheiderivative, kukwira nekudzika, zvinoreva maximum neminimum (chiyero cheCalculus)
m-10.s.s1.prompt: Tarisa tebhura uye usarudze ma functions ose aunotonga kuti ane kukosha kwakanyanyisa (maximum kana minimum) pa x=0.
m-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kune function imwe neimwe, fananidza zviratidzo ze f' kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=0.
m-10.s.s1.hint.1: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti kana chiratidzo chichichinja, function inochinja kubva pakukwira kuenda pakudzika (kana zvakapesana).
m-10.s.s1.r.a: Kana wakasiya x²: chiratidzo che f' chinochinja kubva ku − kuenda ku +. Ndipo apo function inobva pakudzika kuenda pakukwira, saka iminimum.
m-10.s.s1.r.b: Chiratidzo che f'(x) i + pamberi nepashure pe x=0. Inokwira, inomira kwenguva pa0, wobva yakwira zvakare, saka haisi kukosha kwakanyanyisa.
m-10.s.s1.r.c: Kana wakasiya −x⁴: chiratidzo che f' chinochinja kubva ku + kuenda ku −. Ndipo apo function inobva pakukwira kuenda pakudzika, saka imaximum.
m-10.s.s1.explain: Kune x², chiratidzo che f' chinochinja kubva ku − kuenda ku +, saka iminimum, uye kune −x⁴, chinochinja kubva ku + kuenda ku −, saka imaximum. Kune x³, f'(0)=0 asi chiratidzo hachichinji, saka haisi kukosha kwakanyanyisa.
m-10.s.s2.prompt: Ndekupi kutonga kunokodzera zvikuru pamusoro pechirevo chaJihun che "Kana f'(a)=0, saka pane kukosha kwakanyanyisa pa x=a"?
m-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kana chirevo chichiti "nguva dzose," funga kuti chii chinochiita nhema kana pane kunyange nyaya imwe chete.
m-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kune function imwe neimwe mutebhura, fananidza zviratidzo ze f' pamberi nepashure pe x=0 kana f'(0)=0.
m-10.s.s2.o.a: Chokwadi. Ma functions ose matatu mutebhura ane f'(0)=0, saka ane kukosha kwakanyanyisa.
m-10.s.s2.r.a: Ma functions ose matatu ane f'(0)=0, asi maviri chete ndiwo ane kukosha kwakanyanyisa. Tarisa mhedzisiro dzose mutebhura.
m-10.s.s2.o.b: Nhema. Kunyange f'(0)=0, pane function mutebhura isina kukosha kwakanyanyisa.
m-10.s.s2.r.b: Wakaratidza necounterexample imwe chete kuti "nguva dzose" inhema.
m-10.s.s2.o.c: Chokwadi. Maviri pama functions matatu mutebhura ane kukosha kwakanyanyisa, saka inoshanda kune vazhinji.
m-10.s.s2.r.c: Chirevo chinoti "nguva dzose" hachiiti chokwadi nokuti chinoshanda munyaya dzakawanda. Tarisa kana pane nyaya imwe chete isingashande.
m-10.s.s2.o.d: Haigoni kutongwa. Pane ma functions matatu chete mutebhura, saka zvakaoma kusarudza.
m-10.s.s2.r.d: Kunyange nema functions mashoma, kana pane counterexample imwe, unogona kutonga "nguva dzose" kuva nhema. Tarisa kana counterexample iri mutebhura.
m-10.s.s2.explain: f(x)=x³ ine f'(0)=0 asi haisi kukosha kwakanyanyisa, saka i counterexample. Chirevo che "inogara ichishanda" chinova nhema necounterexample imwe chete.
m-10.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira cubic functions mbiri f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (integer coefficients) ne makoshero e a akasiyana, apo f'(0)=0 asi pasina kukosha kwakanyanyisa pa x=0.
m-10.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora f'(x) nenzira ye a, b, ne c, uye uwane f'(0).
m-10.s.s3.hint.1: Fananidza kuti nei x³ mutebhura yaisiri kukosha kwakanyanyisa (chiratidzo che f') uye kuti inosiyana sei ne x².
m-10.s.s3.ok.c1: Iycubic function uye macoefficients ndi integers.
m-10.s.s3.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva integer isiri 0, uye b, c, ne d dzinofanirawo kuva integers.
m-10.s.s3.fail.c2: f'(0) haisi 0. Isa x=0 mu f'(x)=3ax²+2bx+c.
m-10.s.s3.ok.c3: f'(x)=3ax², saka chiratidzo hachichinji pamberi nepashure pe x=0.
m-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Chiratidzo che f'(x) chinochinja pamberi nepashure pe x=0, saka kukosha kwakanyanyisa kunogadzirwa. Tarisa chiratidzo padhuze ne x=0 mu f'(x)=x(3ax+2b).
m-10.s.s3.explain: f'(x)=3ax²+2bx+c, saka f'(0)=c. Kana c=0, saka f'(x)=x(3ax+2b), uye kana b≠0, chiratidzo chinochinja padhuze ne x=0 uye kukosha kwakanyanyisa kunogadzirwa. Kana b=0, saka f'(x)=3ax², saka chiratidzo chakafanana pamberi nepashure pe x=0 uye haisi kukosha kwakanyanyisa.
m-10.s.s4.prompt: Unoda kugadzirisa zvakanaka chirevo chaJihun. Mu "Kana f'(a)=0 ne ______, saka ine kukosha kwakanyanyisa pa x=a," nyora mamiriro anoenda panzvimbo isina chinhu.
m-10.s.s4.hint.0: Kune x² ne −x⁴ (nyaya dzine kukosha kwakanyanyisa) ne x³ (nyaya isina), fananidza kuti chiratidzo che f' chinosiyana sei pamberi nepashure pe x=0.
m-10.s.s4.hint.1: Nyora padivi nedivi zviratidzo kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=0 kune x² ne x³, uye unyore mumutsara mumwe kuti chii chakasiyana.
m-10.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Wakaunyora semamiriro anofananidza kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=a here?
m-10.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Mamiriro anobvisa nyaya ye x³, apo f'(x)=0 pa x=0 asi isiri kukosha kwakanyanyisa here?
m-10.s.s4.model.0: Chiratidzo che f'(x) chinochinja pamberi nepashure pe x=a.
m-10.s.s4.model.1: Inyaya apo, kuruboshwe kwe x=a, inokwira wobva yachinja kudzika kurudyi (kana zvakapesana), ndiko kuti, apo kukwira nekudzika zvinochinjana.
m-10.s.s4.model.2: Kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=a, f'(x) inochinja kubva ku + kuenda ku − kana kubva ku − kuenda ku +.
m-10.s.s4.model.3: f''(a)≠0. (Kana second derivative isiri 0, ikukosha kwakanyanyisa.)
m-10.s.s4.modelNote.3: Iyi isecond derivative test. Imamiriro akakwana asi haisi mamiriro anodiwa.

m-05.title: Purani ipi yakachipa?
m-05.goal: Siyanisa zvaunogona nezvisingagone kuverenga sehumbowo kubva patebhura, uye utsanangure, uchishandisa humbowo, kuti mu linear function relationship kuti ndeipi iri nani kunoenderana nemamiriro (huwandu hwakashandiswa).
m-05.material:
Pane mapurani maviri edata yefoni.
Purani A: mutengo wekutanga 9000원 + 1000원 pa 1GB
Purani B: mutengo wekutanga 3000원 + 1500원 pa 1GB

Mutengo wemwedzi (원) nehuwandu hwakashandiswa
Huwandu hwakashandiswa (GB) | Mutengo wePurani A | Mutengo wePurani B
0 | 9000 | 3000
4 | 13000 | 9000
8 | 17000 | 15000
12 | 21000 | 21000
16 | 25000 | 27000
20 | 29000 | 33000
m-05.thinking.1: Kuenzanisa nekuongorora zvirevo zvakati wandei uchishandisa humbowo
m-05.thinking.2: Kufunga nezvemitengo isiri mutebhura uchishandisa mutemo
m-05.prereq.0: Ma equations nematebhura e linear functions (chimiro chemutengo wekutanga + mutengo wechinhu chimwe)
m-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvaunogona kuverenga kubva patebhura.
m-05.s.s1.hint.0: Mumutsetse wega wega wetebhura, enzanisa mitengo ye A ne B uye uratidze kuti ndeipi diki.
m-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, siyanisa kana inotaura nezvehuwandu hwakashandiswa huri mutebhura chete kana ichienderera kumitengo isiri mutebhura.
m-05.s.s1.o.a: Pahuwandu hwakashandiswa huri mutebhura hwe 0, 4, ne 8GB, B yakachipa.
m-05.s.s1.r.a: Kana wakasiya mitsetse ye 0, 4, ne 8GB: mumitsetse yose mitatu, mutengo we B i mudiki.
m-05.s.s1.r.b: Kana wakasiya mutsetse we 12GB: zvose A ne B i 21000원. Iyi i nzvimbo apo mitengo miviri inochinjana.
m-05.s.s1.o.c: Pahuwandu hwose hwakashandiswa huri mutebhura, A yakachipa kupfuura B.
m-05.s.s1.r.c: Enzanisa mitengo miviri pa 0GB. Dzinotanga dzakasiyana kubva pamutengo wekutanga.
m-05.s.s1.r.d: Kana wakasiya mitsetse ye 16GB ne 20GB: mumitsetse yose miviri, mutengo we A i mudiki.
m-05.s.s1.o.e: Nguva imwe neimwe huwandu hwakashandiswa huchikwira ne 4GB, mutengo we B unokwira ne 4000원.
m-05.s.s1.r.e: Verenga iwe pachako musiyano wemitengo ye B pa 0GB ne 4GB. Kana i 1500원 pa 1GB, 4GB i yakawanda sei?
m-05.s.s1.explain: Pa 0, 4, ne 8GB B yakachipa (3000<9000, 9000<13000, 15000<17000), pa 12GB dzakafanana (21000), uye pa 16GB ne 20GB A yakachipa (25000<27000, 29000<33000). B inokwira ne 6000원 pa 4GB imwe neimwe.
m-05.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari nhatu dzakataura kuti purani ipi yakachipa. Uchifunga zvose tebhura nemitemo yemitengo, chirevo chipi chakakodzera zvikuru?
m-05.s.s2.hint.0: Wana mutebhura kwainochinjana mitengo ye A ne B.
m-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti ndeipi yakachipa pamberi napashure pekuchinjana.
m-05.s.s2.o.a: Jisu: A yakachipa, nekuti mutengo wayo pa 1GB i 1000원, uri shoma kupfuura 1500원 ya B.
m-05.s.s2.r.a: Tarisazve 0GB, 4GB, ne 8GB mutebhura. Kunyange mutengo wechinhu chimwe i wakadzika, chii chinoitika pakutanga nekuda kwemutengo wekutanga?
m-05.s.s2.o.b: Minho: B yakachipa, nekuti mutengo wayo wekutanga i 3000원, wakachipa kupfuura 9000원 ya A.
m-05.s.s2.r.b: Tarisazve 16GB ne 20GB mutebhura. Kana huwandu hwakashandiswa huchikwira, chii chinoitika kumusiyano wemutengo wekutanga?
m-05.s.s2.o.c: Hana: Zvinoenderana nehuwandu hwakashandiswa. Pasi pe 12GB, B yakachipa; pamusoro payo, A yakachipa.
m-05.s.s2.r.c: Kutonga uku kwakarurama kune zvose tebhura nemitemo yemitengo. Mutengo wekutanga nemutengo wechinhu chimwe zvinoenda kumativi akapesana, saka zvinochinjana pa 12GB.
m-05.s.s2.o.d: Junho: I imwechete chero ipi yasarudzwa, nekuti pa 12GB mutengo i mumwechete, 21000원.
m-05.s.s2.r.d: Mutebhura, 12GB ndiro huwandu hwega hwakashandiswa apo mitengo yakafanana. Tarisazve mimwe mitsetse.
m-05.s.s2.o.e: Seoa: Zvinoenderana nehuwandu hwakashandiswa. Pasi pe 8GB, B yakachipa; pamusoro payo, A yakachipa.
m-05.s.s2.r.e: Pa 8GB, B ichiri yakachipa (15000원 ne 17000원). Nzvimbo apo mitengo miviri inova yakaenzana ndokuchinjana i 12GB, kwete 8GB.
m-05.s.s2.explain: Mutengo wekutanga we B wakachipa ne 6000원, uye mutengo wechinhu chimwe we A wakachipa ne 500원. Dzinosangana pa 12GB; pasi peizvozvo B yakachipa, uye pamusoro peizvozvo A yakachipa. Kana ukatarisa huwandu hwakashandiswa humwe chete, unogona kuwanza zvisina kururama sa Jisu kana Minho.
m-05.s.s3.prompt: Ungakurudzira purani ipi kumunhu anoshandisa 10GB pamwedzi? 10GB haipo mutebhura. Nyora kuti wakatonga zvichibva papi.
m-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisazve kuti ndeipi yakachipa mumitsetse ye 8GB ne 12GB, uye funga chokwadi chekuti 10GB iri pakati pazvo.
m-05.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa mitemo yemitengo (mutengo wekutanga nemutengo pa 1GB) kuverenga mitengo yose miviri pa 10GB iwe pachako.
m-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kune 10GB, isiri mutebhura, wakatora mhinduro yako kubva papi (kuverenga nefomula, kana kuva pakati pe 8GB ne 12GB)?
m-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaziva kuti wakanga uchifungidzira kuti mutengo unokwira nemhando yakatsiga here?
m-05.s.s3.model.1: Pa 8GB B yakachipa, uye pa 12GB mitengo yakafanana. 10GB iri pakati pazvo, saka unogona kuti B yakachipa. Asi ndakafungidzira kuti mutengo unokwira nemhando yakatsiga nehuwandu hwakashandiswa.

m-08.title: Wana ma triangles ose ane perimeter 12
m-08.goal: Wana nekuyedza mamiriro ekuumbwa kwe triangle, uye utsanangure kuti unogona kuva nechokwadi sei kuti wawana nenzira yakarongeka mamiriro ose anogutsa mamiriro.
m-08.material: Kune tsvimbo dzakati wandei. Unoda kusarudza tsvimbo nhatu uye kuzvishandisa semativi kugadzira triangle. Hurefu hwetsvimbo hwose i nhamba dzakazara (cm), uye perimeter, huwandu hwehurefu hwose hutatu, i 12cm. Hauzicheki kana kuzvibatanidza pamwe chete.
m-08.thinking.0: Kuyedza fungidziro iwe pachako kuwana mamiriro ekuti ishande
m-08.thinking.2: Kutsanangura chikonzero chekuti wawana ose pasina kusiya
m-08.prereq.1: Zvakakosha zve inequalities (kuenzanisa huwandu hwenhamba mbiri nenhamba imwe)
m-08.s.s1.prompt: Unogona kugadzira triangle kubva patsvimbo nhatu dze 3cm, 3cm, ne 6cm here? (Huwandu i 12cm.) Tonga nekufungidzira kuti uzviise pasi iwe pachako.
m-08.s.s1.hint.0: Isa tsvimbo refu zvikuru, 6cm, pasi, uye umise tsvimbo mbiri dzimwe kumagumo ose maviri kuti dzibate.
m-08.s.s1.hint.1: Wedzera hurefu hwetsvimbo mbiri dzimwe uye uenzanise netsvimbo refu zvikuru.
m-08.s.s1.r.a: 3+3+6=12, saka perimeter yakarurama. Asi kuva neperimeter yakarurama kwakasiyana nekuti triangle ivhare. Chii chinoitika kana ukaisa tsvimbo mbiri dzichitsigira tsvimbo ye 6cm?
m-08.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga kwakanaka. Kunyange ukabatanidza tsvimbo mbiri dze 3cm pamusoro petsvimbo ye 6cm, hurefu hwakafanana, saka hapana vertex yepamusoro inoumbwa.
m-08.s.s1.o.c: Haugoni kuziva kusvika wazvidhirowa iwe pachako.
m-08.s.s1.r.c: Unogona kufunga nekufananidza kureba kwematsvimbo, pasina kudhirowa. Ndekupi kureba kwaunofanira kufananidza?
m-08.s.s1.explain: Kunyange ukabatanidza matsvimbo maviri e3cm, kureba i6cm, kwakafanana netsvimbo ye6cm. Matsvimbo maviri anorara akaenzana pamusoro petsvimbo ye6cm uye hapana vertex inogadzirwa, saka haigadzire triangle.
m-08.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise matriangle ose akasiyana ane perimeter ye12cm apo kureba kwemativi kwose kuri nhamba dzakazara. (Matriangle ane mativi akasiyana nekutevedzana chete anoverengwa setriangle imwe chete.)
m-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kureba kwedivi rakareba zvikuru, wobva wawana huwandu hwemamwe mativi maviri hunoenderana nahwo.
m-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana mativi matatu awakagadzira achigadzira triangle nekufananidza divi rakareba zvikuru nehuwandu hwemamwe mativi maviri.
m-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota shandisa nhamba dzakazara dzi1 kana kupfuura kukureba kwemativi.
m-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Triangle haigadzirwi. Fananidza divi rakareba zvikuru nehuwandu hwemamwe mativi maviri.
m-08.s.s2.explain: Matriangle chete anosangana nemamiriro i (2, 5, 5), (3, 4, 5), ne (4, 4, 4). Kana divi rakareba zvikuru riri rakaenzana kana rakakura kupfuura huwandu hwemamwe mativi maviri, seye (3, 3, 6) kana (1, 5, 6), hapana triangle inogadzirwa.
m-08.s.s3.prompt: Unogona kuva nechokwadi sei kuti "izvi ndizvo zvose, hapana zvimwe"? Tsanangura nzira yawakashandisa kuzviwana zvose pasina kusiya.
m-08.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wawana hurefu hukuru nehudiki zvikuru hunogona kuva hwedivi rakareba zvikuru.
m-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kana divi rakareba zvikuru rasarudzwa, nyora kuti huwandu hwemamwe mativi maviri i chii uye utarise pairi rega rega rinogoneka rimwe nerimwe.
m-08.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana divi rakareba zvikuru ri ...
m-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakajeka kuti muyero upi (seyedivi rakareba zvikuru) wawakashandisa kupatsanura kuita nyaya here?
m-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaongorora nenhamba kuti ndeapi anogoneka uye asingagoneke munyaya imwe neimwe here?
m-08.s.s3.model.0: Divi rakareba zvikuru rinofanira kuva pazasi pe6, saka ri5 kana pazasi, uye ri12÷3=4 kana kupfuura. Kana divi rakareba zvikuru ri4, pane 4,4,4 chete. Kana ri5, huwandu hwemamwe maviri i7, saka pane nzira mbiri: (2,5) ne (3,4). Saka pane matatu muhuwandu.
m-08.s.s3.model.1: Ndakaongorora nenzira kubva pakanga pachiva nedivi pfupi zvikuru 1 kusvika pa4. Kana ri1, huwandu hwemamwe maviri i11, uye ose seye 5,6 haagadzire triangle; kana ri2, 5,5; kana ri3, 4,5; kana ri4, 4,4. Kuongorora imwe nenguva seizvi, hapana chakasiiwa.
m-08.s.s3.model.2: Ndakagadzika divi rimwe ndikapatsanura huwandu hwakasara. Kana divi rakareba zvikuru ri5, huwandu hwemamwe maviri i7, saka (2,5) ne (3,4); kana ri4, (4,4) chete. Ndakaongorora nyaya yega yega nenzira iyi, saka pane 3.
